recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片細胞量明顯增加，有三系造血、數個巨核細胞、少量褐色含鐵血黃素與局部纖維束；此倍率無法辨識漿細胞增多，需高倍或 CD138 染色確認。
features: Markedly hypercellular marrow with little residual fat
Trilineage hematopoiesis with numerous scattered megakaryocytes
Focal streaming fibrous/stromal bands at left
Plasma cells not individually assessable at this magnification
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at low power shows a markedly hypercellular marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis, numerous dispersed megakaryocytes, and focal streaming stromal bands. Scattered hemosiderin deposits are present. Plasma cells cannot be reliably identified or quantified at this magnification. The overall picture is that of a hypercellular reactive marrow, which in the HIV setting commonly accompanies polyclonal plasmacytosis; higher-power evaluation with CD138 and kappa/lambda stains is required.

ddx.vs: MPNs show clustered, atypical megakaryocytes and increased reticulin with driver mutations, which are not evident in this dispersed pattern.
MDS requires morphologic dysplasia on aspirate and/or clonal cytogenetic abnormalities, which cannot be assessed at this power.
Myeloma would show interstitial clusters or sheets of monotypic plasma cells on higher power and immunostains.
